shortDescription: This module manages hosts on IBM Spectrum Virtualize family storage systems

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the Spectrum Virtualize storage system.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: fcwwpn
options.description: List of Initiator WWPNs to be added to the host. The complete list of WWPNs must be provided. The parameters I(fcwwpn) and I(iscsiname) are mutually exclusive. Required when I(state=present), to create or modify a Fibre Channel (FC) host.

options.name: hostcluster
options.description: Specifies the name of the host cluster to which the host object is to be added. A host cluster must exist before a host object can be added to it. Parameters I(hostcluster) and I(nohostcluster) are mutually exclusive. Valid when I(state=present), to create or modify a host.

options.name: iogrp
options.description: Specifies a set of one or more input/output (I/O) groups from which the host can access the volumes. Once specified, this parameter cannot be modified. Valid when I(state=present), to create a host.

options.name: iscsiname
options.description: List of Initiator IQNs to be added to the host. IQNs are separated by comma. The complete list of IQNs must be provided. The parameters I(fcwwpn) and I(iscsiname) are mutually exclusive. Valid when I(state=present), to create host.

options.name: log_path
options.description: Path of debug log file.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies a name or label for the new host object.

options.name: nohostcluster
options.description: If specified as C(True), host object is removed from the host cluster. Parameters I(hostcluster) and I(nohostcluster) are mutually exclusive. Valid when I(state=present), to modify an existing host.

options.name: nqn
options.description: List of initiator NQNs to be added to the host. Each NQN is separated by a comma. The complete list of NQNs must be provided. Required when I(protocol=rdmanvme), to create. Valid when I(state=present), to create or modify a host.

options.name: old_name
options.description: Specifies the old name of the host while renaming. Valid when I(state=present), to rename an existing host.

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: portset
options.description: Specifies the portset to be associated with the host. Valid when I(state=present), to create or modify a host.

options.name: protocol
options.description: Specifies the protocol used by the host to communicate with the storage system. Only 'scsi' protocol is supported. Valid when I(state=present), to create a host.

options.name: site
options.description: Specifies the site name of the host. Valid when I(state=present), to create or modify a host.

options.name: state
options.description: Creates or updates (C(present)) or removes (C(absent)) a host.

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. To generate a token, use the M(ibm.spectrum_virtualize.ibm_svc_auth) module.

options.name: type
options.description: Specifies the type of host. Valid when I(state=present), to create or modify a host.

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validates certification.
